description: The data part of the A2A artifact the knowledge agent attaches when it completes a task. The text part carries the same answer as prose; this is what a consumer reads to render it structured. `usage` says what the answer cost -- model calls and tokens -- which is what makes 'two agents in parallel' and 'one agent doing both' comparable.
